_atelier_note: W8.3 + trust-fence PreToolUse + GAP-6 Stop hook scaffold. Merge into `.claude/settings.json` to enable. Each command resolves the hooks dir in four tiers — $ATELIER_HOOKS_DIR, then $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/atelier/hooks (dev clone), then ${ATELIER_HOME:-$HOME/.atelier}/current/hooks (packaged install), then the framework clone derived from the `atelier` binary on PATH (a DEVELOPMENT install used from a consumer project, where the first three cannot resolve) — and prints one actionable line to stderr if none resolve, so a guard is never silently inert. PreToolUse is two groups: block-prototype-read.sh is the only guard that acts on the read-side tools, so it alone carries Read, Grep and Glob; the five mutation guards bind Edit|MultiEdit|Write|NotebookEdit|Bash (NG26). The Stop array holds one gate: stop-gate.sh enforces W5 TWIN/FUZZ/SOAK markers AND — only once a project runs `atelier stop-gate enable` — the GAP-6 close-marker backstop; it is inert on a fresh repo, so wiring this is safe. The SessionStart entry (session-path.sh) is not a guard: it puts the resolved framework bin/ on PATH for the session's shells via $CLAUDE_ENV_FILE, so `! al ...` works on a fresh clone with no install step, and prints nothing. The second SessionStart entry (session-resume-gates.sh, matcher resume|fork) is not a guard either: a frontmatter Stop hook (the /drive and /rigor gates) does not survive `claude --resume`, so when a drive or a /rigor contract is live for the resumed session it tells the operator to type the command again, and prints nothing otherwise. Neither gate is in this file: SKILL.md's and rigor.md's frontmatter arm them when /drive or /rigor is invoked.

hooks.command: sh -c 'A=; H=0; for d in "${ATELIER_HOOKS_DIR:-}" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/atelier/hooks" "${ATELIER_HOME:-$HOME/.atelier}/current/hooks"; do [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/$1" ] && H=1; done; if [ "$H" = 0 ]; then b=$(command -v atelier 2>/dev/null); n=0; while [ -n "$b" ] && [ -L "$b" ] && [ $n -lt 10 ]; do t=$(readlink "$b"); case $t in /*) b=$t;; *) b=$(dirname "$b")/$t;; esac; n=$((n+1)); done; if [ -n "$b" ]; then A=$(dirname "$(dirname "$(dirname "$b")")")/atelier/hooks; [ -f "$A/$1" ] || A=$(dirname "$(dirname "$b")")/hooks; fi; fi; for d in "${ATELIER_HOOKS_DIR:-}" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/atelier/hooks" "${ATELIER_HOME:-$HOME/.atelier}/current/hooks" "$A"; do [ -n "$d" ] && [ -f "$d/$1" ] && exec bash "$d/$1"; done; echo "atelier: $1 not found (set ATELIER_HOOKS_DIR); guard inert" >&2' _ block-prototype-read.sh
